_about: Fixed offline figures quoted on /ph and /try, each with source and date; the pages label them as fixed offline figures. Only the /ph live track record is computed from saved forecast files.

reactions_eval.label: past launches scored against their real comments by a stronger judge (gemini-2.5-pro) that separates the same specific point from the same topic; generic list = 6 typical launch comments; two halves of real commenters agree on the same point about 35% of the time
reactions_eval.source: E5 reports/same_point/ (strict same-point judge vs the generic 6-item list), branch claude/person-model-v2

similar_tools_auc.label: held-out uses, popularity- and length-matched; tools are a November snapshot

rank_band_coverage.label: month-forward, bands built only from earlier months

matches_vs_voting.label: 114 past launches, Aug-Oct 2026, top-100 matches vs activity-matched members

exp_votes_error.label: median absolute error of predicted day-end votes (pre-reveal points: 3 days; post-reveal points: 4 days)

reactions_vs_humans.label: 158 launches from Aug-Oct 2026, measured on their PH descriptions, simulated reactions vs a random half of the real comments predicting the other half

launch_model_backtest.label: current clean backtest of the 00:05 model with 00:05-visible inputs only (214 days)
launch_model_backtest.pick_label: conservative clean backtest (no site features, 207 days)

try_e2e.label: description band: rank correlation 0.42 on the 130 most recent launches and 0.35 on 856 Sep–Nov launches; the real rank fell inside the band about 3 times in 4 (856 launches), all forward (retrained on earlier months only)
try_e2e.ph_note: PH-description band figures are forward only: the same recipe retrained on earlier months; the earlier 0.59 / 89% were in-sample (launch_band.json was trained through Nov 10, including the 130 launches)
try_e2e.ph_source: E5 forward check of results/web/launch_band.json recipe, relayed by orchestrator 2026-11-13

page_band.label: page-trained band, 856 held-out launches (trained to Aug 31; pooled, page summary + excerpt)

try_stability.label: 60 fresh launches run twice through this site's code; page read at temperature 0 gives an identical band

top_items.label: 70 past launches, top item judged against real comments by gemini-2.5-pro for the same specific point, two independent adjudications
